draft.headline: Top AI models complete only about 60% of tasks on the new ShellBench benchmark.
draft.threads_post:
Even the top frontier AI models hit only about a 60% completion rate on agent tasks.

The OpenClaw Foundation launched ShellBench to evaluate 13 frontier models across five harnesses on 100 tasks. The findings suggest AI agent systems still aren't always dependable.

Are AI agents ready for enterprise work, or is 60% too low?
